world.title: Friday Squid Blogging: I Caught a Squid
world.summary: On Wednesday I spent a day fishing, on a small boat out of Gloucester, MA. We caught many cod (none of which we could keep), and a bunch of hake and mackerel (all of which we could keep).
world.raw_summary: On Wednesday I spent a day fishing, on a small boat out of Gloucester, MA. We caught many cod (none of which we could keep), and a bunch of hake and mackerel (all of which we could keep). And…I caught a squid! Near as I can tell, it’s a longfin squid, sometimes called a Boston squid ( Doryteuthis (Amerigo) pealeii ). That night I cooked it over a barbecue grill—hot and fast. Delicious.
